body.x: The Daegu Techno Park Mobile Convergence Center participated in CES 2017 (Consumer Technology Show), the world's largest IT appliance exhibition in Las Vegas, US from January 5 to 8.

Choi Seok-kweon, CEO of Daegu Techno Park Mobile Convergence Center said, "We are expecting a lot of contract results through this exhibition, and some contracting news is already being done", and "Especially when these marketing events contribute to the sales and performance of small and medium companies."

Also he said "We are currently forming a Daegu Joint Pavilion together with Daegu City, and we will continue to cooperate with Daegu City in the future to provide high-quality exhibition quality to SMEs so that the promotion effect can take place."

The Daegu Techno Park Mobile Convergence Center has been providing support to CES so that Daegu's start-up business, small business and medium-sized companies will be able to achieve marketing results through exhibitions for the fourth year in a row. This year, 22 companies from Daegu will participate in the Daegu Joint Pavilion to meet various related industry workers, buyers and distributors.
The Daegu Techno Park Mobile Convergence Center has participated in the CES six companies including Falcon, RF, Network Korea, Samjjeomilsa, IT Health, Griffon Dynamics.

On the other hand, Daegu Techno Park, Kyungpook National University Smart Venture Founding School and Kyungpook National University Smart Drone Technology Center opened CES Daegu Joint Pavilion and support the exhibition management and business buyer consultation of 22 companies in Korea.

CES, the world's largest IT appliance exhibition, is an annual showcase of the global consumer electronics industry and is held annually in January by the American Consumer Electronics Association (CTA).

Having reported the most recent issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, the world's top three tech exhibitions over the last decade, AVING NEWS is sending out a special report team to CES this year to report major market issues and introduce Korean companies to the world.
